title: Tidewell sales pitch (fictional company, example data)

brief.motion: Product launch: warm canvas, springy UI reveals with a small overshoot, a cursor that acts, crisp counters. Camera eases in towards whatever is being said.
brief.story: A plain sales deck becomes a product launch film for a fictional helpdesk tool. Opens on a dark overflowing inbox (the pain), turns light for the product, ends on a bold result.

slides.title: Tidewell
slides.notes: Your support inbox never sleeps. Neither does Tidewell.
slides.storyboard: night stage, a phone-style notification stack keeps arriving and piling up. On 'Neither' a wave of teal light sweeps through, the notifications fold away and the Tidewell wordmark forms.

slides.title: The problem
bullets: Customers wait hours for a reply
Agents answer the same questions again and again
slides.notes: Tickets pile up overnight, and customers wait hours for a first reply. Meanwhile, your team answers the same five questions again and again.
slides.storyboard: a ticket queue counter climbs as a clock spins through the night; a 'waiting' timer ticks up in coral on 'hours'. On 'same five questions' five identical question cards repeat in a loop, stamped 'again'.

slides.title: How Tidewell works
bullets: Sorts every ticket by topic and urgency
Drafts answers from your help centre
slides.notes: Tidewell sorts every ticket by topic and urgency. It drafts the answer from your own help centre, and your team just reviews and sends.
slides.storyboard: light canvas, product UI. Tickets fly into three labelled lanes on 'sorts'; urgency pills light on 'urgency'. A reply drafts itself with help-centre article chips on 'help centre'; a cursor clicks Send on 'sends' and a green tick blooms.

slides.title: Results
slides.notes: In this example, first reply time fell from over nine hours to just over one. Book a demo today.
slides.storyboard: two giant bars on dark: 'Before' rises tall in coral to 9.4h, 'After' snaps down to 1.2h in teal on 'just over one'; a big '-87%' lands. On 'Book a demo' a button lands and a cursor clicks it. Small 'Example data · fictional company' label.
